name: GT2 timing pulley, 16 tooth
summary: 16-tooth GT2 pulley for a 6 mm belt on a 5 mm shaft: 10.2 mm pitch diameter, 13 mm flanges, 14 mm long.
description: A 16-tooth GT2 pulley for a 5 mm shaft and 6 mm belt. It moves 32 mm of belt per turn. Flanges and the mounting hub are included; individual teeth are simplified.
source: Pitch diameter computed from the 2 mm GT2 pitch: teeth x 2 / pi = 16 x 2 / pi = 10.186 mm. The outside (tooth) diameter is the pitch diameter minus 0.508 mm = 9.68 mm, the value MISUMI's high-torque metric timing pulley table prints for 16 teeth (retailer listings round it to 9.7 mm). Flange diameter 13 mm and overall length 14 mm are approximate: they come from listings for the common 6 mm-belt, 5 mm-bore version (Caxtool gives 13 mm outside over a 9.7 mm toothed body; an Amazon listing gives 13 x 13 x 14 mm), and other makers ship 14-16 mm flanges and 14-16 mm lengths, so treat both figures as check-before-you-cut. Bore 5 mm and belt width 6 mm are the chosen variant, and the set-screw hole is not modelled. Solid and preview include two 0.8 mm flanges around a 6 mm belt barrel, a simplified 9 mm hub and the 5 mm bore. The barrel diameter follows the published pitch diameter minus 0.508 mm; individual teeth and set-screw holes are not cut.
